name: emw-merge-sets
label: EMwrap Merge Sets
help: Merge multiple tilt-series, tomogram, or particle/coordinate sets of the same type into one output set. Particle/coordinate sets can be merged without their overlapping particles (see 'Overlap distance'), and with different columns (see 'Common columns').

params.name: input_sets
params.label: Input sets:
params.help: Two or more STAR files of the same type: tilt_series.star, tomograms.star, or optimisation_set.star (TomoParticles / TomoCoordinates).

params.name: overlap_distance
params.label: Overlap distance (A)
params.help: Only for TomoParticles / TomoCoordinates sets. Empty: every particle is merged (particles with the same name or coordinates only once). Otherwise, a particle within this distance (Angstrom, same tomogram, positions with the shifts) of a particle of an earlier input set is not added: the earlier one is. The particles are then in parts, per tomogram: 'overlap', the ones in more than one set (from the first one), and 'set1', 'set2'... the ones only in that input set. With two sets A and B: set1 is A - B, set2 is B - A and overlap is A & B.

params.name: edge_distance
params.label: Edge distance (A)
params.help: Only for TomoParticles / TomoCoordinates sets. Particles closer than this distance (Angstrom) to the edges of the tomogram box (X, Y and Z; positions with the shifts, sizes from the tomograms.star of each set) are not merged; they are left out before the overlaps. Empty: none.

params.name: exclude_parts
params.label: Exclude parts
params.help: Optional, with an overlap distance: the parts left out of some tomograms, e.g. 'TS_01: set2' merges only A - B and A & B of TS_01. The tomogram name '*' is every tomogram, e.g. '*: set1 set2' keeps only the overlaps (a consensus of the sets).

params.name: tomoName
params.label: Tomo name
params.help: rlnTomoName of the tomogram, or '*' for every tomogram.

params.name: parts
params.label: Parts
params.help: Parts to leave out, separated by spaces: 'overlap', 'set1', 'set2'...

params.name: common_columns
params.label: Common columns
params.help: Only for TomoParticles / TomoCoordinates sets. No: the sets must have the same particle columns. Yes: only the particle columns of every set are written (an origin missing in a set is 0), e.g. to merge picked coordinates with extracted particles; the optics tables only if every set has one. The output is TomoParticles if every set is, else TomoCoordinates.
